# Official IIT Python runtime placeholder

No cryptographic binaries are committed to this repository.

Place an officially supplied, version-matched `EUSignCP.py` and `_EUSignCP.pyd` here only after verifying their source, SHA-256 hashes, supported CPython ABI and x86 architecture. The `.gitignore` excludes `.pyd` and `.dll` files so they cannot be committed accidentally.

Never place a JKS, private key, password file or generated Authorization value in this directory.
